item.title: Navy intercepts P63-M worth of smuggled goods
item.description: ZAMBOANGA CITY (MindaNews / 25 January) — Three vessels carrying undocumented cargo worth P63-M were intercepted in the waters off Sulu on December 28, 2025 and January 5, 2026, the Western Mindanao Naval Command reported on Saturday. “The total estimated value of the seized items” — rice, sugar and cigarettes and the vessels themselves – is P63,989,973.40, […]

item.title: Shariff Aguak mayor survives ambush; 3 attackers killed
item.description: COTABATO CITY (MindaNews / 25 January) — A daring early Sunday morning ambush using a rocket-propelled grenade and targeting Shariff Aguak Mayor Akmad Ampatuan failed to kill the mayor but injured two of his escorts. item.title: Bone and teeth samples taken from 5 cadavers to identify victims; 6th cadaver recovered
item.description: DAVAO CITY (MindaNews / 25 January) — Teeth and bone samples were collected on Sunday from the five cadavers believed to have been among the missing passengers and crew members of the ill-fated M/Bca Amejara, to establish their identities through deoxyribonucleic acid or DNA testing. item.title: Sulu-bound ship sinks off Basilan; 18 dead, 40 still missing
item.description: Passengers and crew of MV Trisha Kerstin 3 are shown being rescued by Philippine Coast Guard personnel. The ship sank 2.7 nautical miles northeast of Baluk-Baluk Island, Basilan a few hours after leaving Zamboanga City for Jolo, Sulu Sunday evening, January 25. From the Facebook page of Coast Guard District Southwestern Mindanao (CGDSWM)

item.title: Bangsamoro peace implementation lags in global average – expert
item.description: MindaNews / 26 January — More than a decade after the signing of the Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro (CAB), its implementation is lagging behind the global average for similar peace agreements, hampered by delayed decommissioning, slow amnesty uptake, and postponed regional elections, among others, an expert on international peace processes said. item.description: Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur Mayor Akmad Ampatuan is asking for more security escorts saying he is shocked at the firepower used in the latest attempt on his life. MindaNews photo by Ferdinandh Cabrera

item.title: COMMENTARY: Term limits, not dynasties, deserve a second look
item.description: The proposed anti-dynasty bill (HB 6771 and SB 35) has once again ignited public debate on political reform.
